text:
We are COVID-19 patients.
And we chose to self-isolate at home.
We contacted 1330 many times,
but received no call back!!!
So we tried calling the public health office in our area,
Taling Chan district, or Public Health Center 49 (search for it on Google).
It was easy to get through, and the staff gave us another contact number
for direct COVID-related matters.
The other line was a bit harder to get through, but we still managed to.
The staff were very polite, provided excellent service, and were more knowledgeable than even the staff at private hospitals.
They asked about our medical history and symptoms.
They even let us add their LINE account for contact.
We contacted them around 10:00 AM.
Around 3 or almost 4:00 PM, we received a call saying...
We could come pick up our medication. 🙏🥰👍 We were very impressed.
The medication included Favipharmacist and was tailored to our symptoms.
There are two people in our family who are infected, with different symptoms, and they received different medications.
It was great, I have to say. Thank you from the bottom of my heart. ❤❤❤
